sentences.text: In an upset, behold the lamb took down Bo Girds 114.95 to 109.61.
Lucky waiver pickup Germie Bernard, a recent add, posted 20.2 and decided it, and without him, that is a loss.
The losing starters dropped 7 passes worth about 17.8, and those drops cost them the game.
Matthew Golden dropped 3 of his targets, worth about 14.2 on his own.
The Indianapolis Colts defense, another recent add on the losing side, finished at -0.85.
Rough pickup.
Germie Bernard has beaten projection in 3 of the last 3 weeks.
This week the new pickup hit 20.2 on an 8.13 projection, a lucky waiver add for behold the lamb.
He won it, and since this side sat 11th before the week, knocking off Bo Girds goes down as an upset.
Without Bernard, that is a loss.
Waivers pay.
To Infinity and Bijan named the whole franchise after Bijan Robinson, and he paid them back with 6.3 points, 16.78 under projection, for Underperformer honors.
Ladd McConkey and Terry McLaurin, also on that roster, are now listed Out.
Tre Tucker took a 7.58 projection and turned it into 24.2 for All You Need Is Love, the week's Overachiever.
Germie Bernard, a recent waiver add for behold the lamb, scored 20.2 on a projection under half that and takes Game Changer, about as lucky as a pickup gets.
Bo Girds had Kenneth Walker atop every running back at 26.9 and Tyler Shough right behind the top quarterback.
Maye d'force B with U finally lived up to the pun, with Drake Maye 3rd at quarterback and Isaiah Likely leading every tight end at 20.9.
The force was with them.
Return of T Mac got the top defense in the Steelers and Malik Nabers at 22.5, 2nd among receivers.
Lil Fridge put Brock ‘N’ Roll in cold storage 126.79 to 88.31, and at least the namesake Brock Purdy led the losers in scoring.
Recent adds Dallas Goedert and the Buccaneers defense barely beat projection for the losers, while the Broncos defense, a recent add for the winners, posted 13.35 on a 6.53 projection.
Davante Adams and Mike Evans are now listed Out, and Romeo Doubs is now listed IR.
In an upset, Return of T Mac flattened Unsolicited Dak Picks 120.29 to 81.47.
Carnell Tate, a recent add by trade, posted 16, while fellow trade pickup Jaylen Warren managed 8.8.
On the other side, that 81.47 is a season low, and A.J. Brown, who scored 3.2, is now listed Questionable.
Maye d'force B with U beat Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team 113.55 to 104.04, and Isaiah Likely won it from tight end.
The trade haul dogged its own team: the new pickup Bhayshul Tuten posted 22.7, while fellow trade arrival Garrett Wilson managed 6.4.
Dalton Kincaid, yet another trade arrival, and Jaylen Waddle are now listed Questionable.
Bo Girds' starters dropped 7 passes worth about 17.8, and those drops cost them the game.
The side sitting 11th before the week won it in an upset, with the new pickup Roschon Johnson posting 13.5.
Meanwhile the losing side's own new pickup, the Colts defense, finished below zero.
London Cooking won by 66.4, and the Bijan that To Infinity and Bijan is named after scored 6.3.
The trade for Patrick Mahomes, a recent add, returned 11.48, and somehow that was still this side's top score.
Ladd McConkey and Terry McLaurin, also recent adds by trade, are now listed Out.
All You Need Is Love beat Pukancun on 3 97.02 to 84.07, and Tre Tucker, their Top Scorer, was the decider.
The 1-11 losers traded for Cam Skattebo as a recent add, and he scored 0.
Brutal trade.
The median landed at 106.83, and To Infinity and Bijan finished 60.75 under it.
That 46.08 is a season low, from a side already 2 games below the cut.
That one stings.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team came up 2.79 short, the exact gap Bo Girds cleared it by.
Must Watch is Lil Fridge against Return of T Mac, whose win streak walks straight into the hardest draw in the league next week.
Down in the basement, Pukancun on 3 at 1-11 meets To Infinity and Bijan at 4-8, both below the cut, in a true showdown of the awful.
Lil Fridge stays on top at 10-2, 4 games clear of the cut.
The scoring has cooled to 113.91 a week over the last 3 weeks.
London Cooking has won 4 straight and holds 2nd.
Nobody is stopping them right now.
Bo Girds has lost 2 straight and still holds 3rd.
That leaves a cushion of 2 games over the cut.
Maye d'force B with U climbs to 4th after 2 straight wins.
Still, that 7-5 record is just 1 game above the cut.
Return of T Mac jumps to 5th on 3 straight wins.
The catch: they still sit outside the playoff spots.
All You Need Is Love stays 6th while holding a playoff spot at 7-5.
Turns out they also need points.
behold the lamb leaps 4 places to 7th.
Behold, a 6-6 team that has faced the 2nd toughest schedule played.
Brock ‘N’ Roll falls 4 places to 8th while clinging to the last playoff spot.
The scoring has slipped too.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team slips to 9th after 2 straight losses.
At 4-8, the dog days are here, 2 games below the cut.
Unsolicited Dak Picks has lost 3 straight and owns the last-ranked results over that stretch.
Nobody asked for these picks, and nobody is asking for this record either.
To Infinity and Bijan sits 11th at 4-8.
Infinity is a stretch for an offense averaging 77.06 a week lately.
Pukancun on 3 stays last at 1-11, 5 games below the cut.
At least the scoring is up to 93.93 a week lately.
